Bihar's JD(U) Opposes Uniform Civil Code Implementation

The Janata Dal (United) party in Bihar has stated its opposition to the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) within the state. Senior JD(U) leader and former Minister Shyam Rajak announced that the UCC will not be implemented in Bihar "at any cost." This stance comes despite the party having previously supported the UCC Bill in Parliament. The development highlights a potential rift within the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) regarding the UCC's application in Bihar.
